title: All sudo-proxy subprocess timeout: HasExited fast-path
desc: wkappbot --sudo proxies to admin Eye; 30s WaitForExitAsync timeout must check proc.HasExited to distinguish real hang from grandchild-pipe-hold; affects all sudo-routed commands
steps: In .NET 8, Process.WaitForExitAsync with redirected stdout/stderr waits for BOTH process exit AND stream EOF
If child exits cleanly but grandchild (daemon) inherits stdout pipe, WaitForExitAsync stalls on stream-EOF half and fires 30s timeout with stdoutDone=False
Fix (ElevatedEyeProxy.cs ExecuteCommand): on OperationCanceledException, call proc.Refresh() + check proc.HasExited. If true, grace-drain streams 2s then return ExitCode=proc.ExitCode as success

Only when HasExited=false is it a true hang -- then kill tree + return -1 with timeout Error. Post-exit 3s drain path also no longer tags Error since grandchild holding pipe is a success case, not retry-worthy
Affects all wkappbot --sudo <cmd> invocations that route through ElevatedEyeClient.ExecuteViaProxy

Verified 2026-05-03: Timeout.Infinite (-1) was clamped to 5min by Math.Max(timeoutMs, 300_000) in ExecuteViaProxy line 633. Fix: timeoutMs <= 0 ? Timeout.Infinite : Math.Max(timeoutMs, 300_000). wkappbot --sudo exec C:/KiwoomGlobal/bin/nfstarter.exe (3min HTS watch) no longer returns -1 from premature pipe-read timeout (resolve ts=2026-05-02T21:30:43).
